name: TAFE SA free counselling and wellbeing support
summary: Free, confidential counselling for enrolled TAFE SA students, on campus, by phone or online.
key: A free and confidential Counselling and Wellbeing support to all enrolled students.
how: Book online, or call TAFE SA Customer Support on 1800 882 661.

evidence.quote: a free and confidential Counselling and Wellbeing support to all enrolled students
